about: Questions customers will ask, with what a good answer must and must not do. `npm run ask:eval` asks the real assistant every one and a grader checks the answer. Add real questions from the Conversations tab in the admin desk. Order HK-TEST1 (email layla@example.com, pickup, Najdi x2 + Ramadan Date Box Khalas) exists during the run (a February pickup, not yet collected), and so does HK-PAST1 (same email, delivered six days ago: Najdi + Everyday Date Box Sukkari) for the damaged-item questions. Qassimi is set to sold out during the run. Coffee prices are not set during the run (as before launch): coffee can't be ordered yet.

questions.q: I've never had Arabic coffee. Which one should I start with?
must: recommends one or two specific Hikaya coffees by name
short, plain answer
must_not: uses the words best or premium

questions.q: What's the difference between Najdi and the plain Gulf coffee?
must: says Najdi is Gulf coffee with its saffron packet, always included
says the plain one is Gulf coffee with cardamom only
must_not: says the saffron in Najdi is optional

questions.q: My Najdi coffee has no foam, is that wrong?
must: says Gulf qahwa is clear and golden without foam
only Shami coffee has foam

questions.q: How do I make the Najdi without a dallah?
must: gives the brew steps from the guide (500 ml water, simmer about 10 minutes, settle, strain into the serving dallah)
says the saffron is not boiled: a little is soaked and put in the serving dallah at the end of each pot, with the coffee poured over it
says a small pot works
does not invent a coffee amount: says the grams per pot are still being finalised, or leaves the amount out

questions.q: Can I buy whole beans? I have my own grinder.
must: says every coffee is sold ground for now, no whole beans

questions.q: I'm allergic to sesame. What should I avoid?
must: names the Rada'i pack (Rada'i style) as containing sesame
says the coffee bags themselves are coffee and spices only, or that allergens are only in the sealed packs
says cross-contact cannot be confirmed yet or offers to ask the team

must_not: claims a date is safe for diabetics
